review.reason: The candidate correctly treats November as a four-variant navigation index, preserves May-only Checkout, Direct API and mobile details, fixes the Checkout example and scopes the Stripe.js method. Its opening summary nevertheless conflates save-only setup with the Direct API charge-and-save PaymentIntent path. All pinned hashes, evidence quotes and the concept replacement anchor verify; Q1 and Q2 correctly distinguish the paths.
required_changes: In source-stripe-cash-app-pay-set-up-payment.md candidate line 15, narrow 'A later charge uses a separate PaymentIntent; saving a method does not itself charge it.' The May Checkout setup-mode Session and SetupIntent save for later without an immediate charge, but the May Direct API PaymentIntent path charges at checkout while saving the method with setup_future_usage (old raw lines 95-105, 363-406). A future charge after either saved-method path uses another PaymentIntent (old raw lines 408-427). State these route-specific boundaries in the summary so a reader does not infer that charge-and-save requires a separate later intent or that saving always excludes a contemporaneous charge.

source_decisions.reason: The opening summary's unconditional separate-later-PaymentIntent/no-charge statement conflicts with the dated Direct API PaymentIntent flow that charges at checkout while saving the method; narrow it to save-only versus charge-and-save routes.
